english.meaning: in these recent days; these days
english.note: 哩 is an alternative spelling of 呢, so this is the same as 呢排.

exampleSentences.english: It hurts. But you don’t have that anymore, right? I mean, not lately?
exampleSentences.traditional: 心痛嚹。但係而家又冇哩一樣𡃉喇，係唔係啊？即係哩排又冇話？
